correctness.rationale: Independent marked-key-ring enumeration gives p1=q^(n-1), p2=q r^(n-2), p3=q r u^(n-3). Centering gives kappa3. Strict log concavity of binomial-ratio avoidance ensures u/(qr)<1<q^2/r, so the sign is that of a strictly convex two-exponential function with at most two roots. Explicit cubic logarithmic expansion at n/P->c cancels constant and linear terms and gives the factored K^3(cK-1)(3cK^2-3K-2) coefficient. Its two simple roots and convexity yield the full threshold theorem. The actual standalone checker passed 403 assertions, including independent brute-force assignment enumeration and 90-digit numerical checkpoints; finite checks alone do not prove infinite assertions.

value.rationale: A three-point connected isolation cumulant is the smallest genuinely three-body dependence statistic, and enters factorial-cumulant descriptions of isolated-vertex fluctuations. Its sign displays a sharp twice-changing phase as graph size and fixed key-pool size grow proportionally, beyond the classical known first/second isolation moment and connectivity threshold. The polynomial roots locate canonical transition ratios rather than arbitrary parameter slices; no downstream theorem is asserted.
